# LokTube 1.5.4

- Restore open tabs when LokTube starts again, including the selected tab, tab order, each tab's navigation history, and tab titles.
- Save changes immediately when tabs are opened, closed, selected, navigated, or reordered. The saved session also flushes on application close; bad or outdated data falls back safely to a fresh Home tab.
- Right-click any tab or unused tab-bar space to open **Tab options**, including **Close all tabs**, which resets the session to one fresh Home tab.
- Reorder tabs by drag-and-drop or choose **Move tab left** / **Move tab right** from a tab's context menu. Order is remembered on restart.
- Preserve secure YouTube deep links so clicking from the Zen extension still opens a new LokTube tab.
